column1: # Kolosova 2024, El lenguaje cifrado en tiempos de Carlos V (1521-1527), Ediciones Universidad de Salamanca.

# Cifrario 10, Lope Hurtado (secondary cipher, Tomokiyo's Ko.10): substitution alphabet p.211, nomenclature pp.212-213. Transcribed 17 Oct 2026 by the account-4 parent from the owner's ILL scan (OCLC 1541749253, TN 238338999; PDF off the repository, copyright).
# Published key (grade H as a key source, rule 10 'published'); `tx` = my reading of the printed group: H clear, M doubtful (note says why).

# Notation: the printed prefix signs are written as the Latin letter they resemble: 3 (= Bourdeau's z), y (= Bourdeau's ɣ), x, t, s (long s, = Bourdeau's ʃ), r; cifra 10 adds f, d, p. The two or three letters after the prefix are as printed.
